plugins.name: legal-toolkit-from-andrea
plugins.description: A growing library of litigation skills: court-filing formatting, PDF-to-text conversion, court-filing PDF renaming, calendar-true date checking, NY Tanbook citations, offline Bankruptcy Code lookup, case-law research and memo drafting (CourtListener), an AI cite-check pipeline (eyecite + CourtListener + Isaacus), a verbatim-source jury-charge drafter/auditor (bring your own pattern library), and a shared first-run setup. Identity-, DMS-, and jurisdiction-agnostic.
